questiontext.text: In the Factory Method pattern, who decides which concrete class to instantiate?

answer.text: Subclasses that override the creation method

feedback.text: Correct — subclasses decide which concrete product to create.

answer.text: A single global instance shared by all clients

feedback.text: That describes Singleton, not Factory Method.

answer.text: A Director that sequences building steps

feedback.text: That describes Builder, not Factory Method.

answer.text: A wrapper that converts one interface into another

feedback.text: That describes Adapter, not Factory Method.

generalfeedback.text: Factory Method defines an interface for creating an object but lets subclasses decide which class to instantiate.

questiontext.text: Into which GoF category does Factory Method fall?

answer.text: Creational

feedback.text: Correct — Factory Method is a creational pattern about object creation.

answer.text: Structural

feedback.text: No — structural patterns compose classes/objects.

answer.text: Behavioral

feedback.text: No — behavioral patterns concern communication and responsibility.

generalfeedback.text: Factory Method is a creational pattern, like Builder and Singleton.

questiontext.text: What key benefit does Factory Method provide?

answer.text: It decouples client code from the concrete product classes

feedback.text: Correct — clients depend only on the product interface.

answer.text: It guarantees a class has exactly one instance

feedback.text: No — that is Singleton.

answer.text: It composes objects into part-whole tree hierarchies

feedback.text: No — that is Composite.

generalfeedback.text: By creating products through an overridable method, the client is decoupled from concrete product classes.

answer.text: An interface (method) for creating an object

feedback.text: Correct — it defines a creation interface whose concrete result is chosen by subclasses.

answer.text: A single shared instance and a global access point

feedback.text: No — that is Singleton.

answer.text: A way to attach responsibilities dynamically by wrapping

feedback.text: No — that is Decorator.

generalfeedback.text: Factory Method defines the interface for creating an object while deferring the concrete choice to subclasses.

questiontext.text: Which statements about Factory Method are true? (select all that apply)

answer.text: Subclasses override the factory method to choose the concrete product

feedback.text: Yes — that is how the concrete class is selected.

answer.text: It promotes loose coupling between client code and concrete products

feedback.text: Yes — clients depend on the product interface, not concrete classes.

answer.text: It guarantees that only one instance of the product ever exists

feedback.text: No — that is Singleton.

answer.text: It requires composing products into a part-whole tree

feedback.text: No — that is Composite.

generalfeedback.text: Factory Method defers instantiation to subclasses and decouples clients from concrete product classes.
